claims.statement: Deftform v1.0 became public on April 2, 2024.
Deftform supports unlimited responses, forms embedded by script, file uploads, Stripe payments, logic, teams, webhooks, notifications, and API access.
Prepaid forms have been sold in groups of five for €15, while the current AppSumo lifetime offer is $49. Optional Business costs €18 monthly and Extended €19 once.
Quick setup, clean design, straightforward embedding, and one-time pricing are dominant positive themes.
Advanced layout, styling, workflow, and data controls remain common requests, while bugs and support delays appear in a small recent complaint cluster.

scoreRationale.onboarding: A normal form can be built quickly, and the first form is free to try.
scoreRationale.product: Core forms, logic, payments, files, and connections are broad for the price. Advanced control and production reliability need more proof.
scoreRationale.support: Many older accounts praise support, but recent serious complaints show slower or defensive handling.
scoreRationale.billing: Unlimited responses and one-time options are attractive. Paid add-ons mean lifetime does not include every future business need.
scoreRationale.overall: Deftform is a promising low-cost form builder for normal intake and lead forms, but business-critical use should wait for a full reliability and export test.

conflictsAndUnknowns: AppSumo ratings are very high but platform diversity is weak.
Support is praised overall but criticized in recent low ratings.
No hands-on embed, payment, file, export, outage, or support test was completed.
